name: Seeed reTerminal E1004
description: 13.3 inch 6-colour Spectra 6 ePaper terminal, ESP32-S3, battery-powered (up to 6-month runtime at 1 refresh/day per Seeed). Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API when flashed with the tesserae-device-firmware ESP-IDF build (unified firmware, boards/seeed_reterminal_e1004.h). Server-side pack via esp32_bin produces a 4-bpp Spectra 6 buffer (960000 bytes) that the firmware paints without any on-device quantise.
notes_md: Confirmed on real hardware running tesserae-device-firmware. If you flashed the reTerminal with TRMNL firmware instead of the tesserae-device-firmware build, use the (planned) `seeed_reterminal_e1004_trmnl` variant which routes through the TRMNL BYOS protocol + colour PNG renderer.
